decisions.reason: Moving the LEDs from 5V to 3.3V does not change the two OR-ed power sources, diode method, or source-selection behavior.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY setting the LED supply to 3.3V, removing the level-shifter part, and specifying direct ESP32 drive.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY adding the SK6812 LEDs to the monitored 3.3V downstream-current coverage.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY removing the LEDs from the switched 5V load list while retaining the two 5V sensors.
The LED supply change does not alter the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology, battery input range, or normal battery power path.
The LED rail change does not alter the battery connector, pinout, placement, supported voltage range, or AXP2101 destination.
The DCDC1 configuration remains 3.4V to maintain the downstream 3.3V rail; adding LEDs to that rail does not change its setpoint or compensation rule.
Changing the electrical supply for the LEDs does not change the presence, count, destination, or type of the LED connector.
References to the ESP32 and 3.3V rail are incidental; the panel controls, touch inputs, GPIO mappings, and button connections remain unchanged.
The source changes the main-board SK6812 supply and does not change any sensor-board connector, pinout, or connector count.
The LED voltage and data-threshold decision does not affect the I2C series-resistor value, placement, purpose, or population policy.
The source does not modify or remove the requirement for local main-board decoupling capacitors.
